newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge on fund inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge on fund inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates plunged on Sunday on the inflow of about 500 million rupees, ending a week-long fund shortage, dealers said.
The overnight funds were opened at 11 percent but sharply came down to four percent due to excess liquidity, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
At the end of the day, offers were seen at the level of three percent but no borrowing interest was seen, and the market closed at two percent, the dealer said.
